senses.gloss: [twins,] the central leaf of the palm branch, which is a junction of two.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 32a:7">Succ. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>נחלקה הת׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 <he>התַּיֶּימֶת</he>) if the central leaf is split; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 96a">B. Kam. 96ᵃ</cite>; a. e.

Pesik. R. s. 15 (ref. to תמתי, Cant. V, 2) תְּיוֹמָתִי לא אני גדול וכ׳ my match, I am not greater than she, nor is she greater than I; (Cant. R. to l. c. תאומתי כביכול).—Trnsf. a broken thread joined by twisting, thick thread.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:46">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ</cite> <he>אפי׳ ערב שבה לא היה בו קשר ולא תיימת</he> even in the woof of the curtain there was neither a knot nor a twist.
